name: Rex the Hunt!
review:
Rex the Hunt! is a 6-reel dinosaur slot with 178 connecting ways, wilds and a free spins bonus.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 4,000x cap and a 96.16% RTP.

The 178 connecting ways give the grid an unusual shape, and wilds help bridge the gaps. Free spins are where the dinosaur hunt pays off.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
